title: Recover the job without corrupting the experiment
description: Choose an evidence contract, inject a provider-side failure, and select retry and provenance policies. The trace shows whether the workflow duplicates execution, repeats a completion effect, or accepts unusable evidence.
modelNote: The scenarios model control-plane behavior, not quantum physics. Provider APIs differ, so production adapters must map these invariants to documented idempotency, cancellation, calibration, and result semantics.

contracts.label: Exploratory run
contracts.detail: Useful for direction finding; incomplete evidence may be retained but must be labeled.

contracts.label: Comparative benchmark
contracts.detail: Requires complete shots and enough provenance to compare reruns honestly.

contracts.label: Controlled decision run
contracts.detail: A consequential result requires complete, signed evidence and a narrow calibration window.

scenarios.label: Healthy completion
scenarios.detail: The provider acknowledges one job and returns all requested shots once.

scenarios.label: Acceptance response lost
scenarios.detail: The provider accepted the job, but the client timed out before receiving its job ID.

scenarios.label: Duplicate completion callback
scenarios.detail: At-least-once delivery sends the same terminal event twice.

scenarios.label: Calibration window expired
scenarios.detail: Queue delay means the job executes against calibration evidence older than the contract allows.

scenarios.label: Partial result returned
scenarios.detail: The provider returns only 62% of requested shots after an execution interruption.

scenarios.label: Result checksum mismatch
scenarios.detail: The received counts do not match the digest recorded in the execution manifest.

recoveryPolicies.label: Blind resubmit
recoveryPolicies.detail: Create a new request after a timeout and apply every completion callback.

recoveryPolicies.label: Idempotent submit and resume
recoveryPolicies.detail: Reuse one experiment key, reconcile provider job state, and deduplicate terminal events.

recoveryPolicies.label: Fail closed for review
recoveryPolicies.detail: Do not resubmit automatically; reconcile uncertain provider state before deciding.

evidencePolicies.label: Counts only
evidencePolicies.detail: Store the outcome histogram without circuit, compiler, backend, calibration, or shot provenance.

evidencePolicies.label: Versioned execution manifest
evidencePolicies.detail: Store circuit hash, compiler settings, backend, calibration ID, requested and completed shots, and result digest.

evidencePolicies.label: Signed evidence bundle
evidencePolicies.detail: Protect the versioned manifest and result digest with a verifiable service signature.
